scope: Exact literal item-year resolution v1.3 against LCV2025; independent review of coordinator change.
observations: Calendar candidates derive only from canonical official vote IDs and valid actual official vote dates.
No edition-year fallback or Congress/session arithmetic supplies a missing source fact.
Committee, bill and sponsorship actions cannot become floor votes from item year alone.
Every actual LCV item resolved uniquely against pinned official rows; source item Year remained literal.

finding_closed.description: Contradictory typed upstream vote year and item year previously retained an unresolved tentative vote in one direction.
finding_closed.correction: Explicit differing years now add contradictory_source_vote_years; conflict clears targets and preserves candidates.
finding_closed.tests: Both contradiction directions plus historical/date/ambiguity tests pass; 80 resolver tests.

traces.behavior: Indexes valid official date and canonical chamber/session/roll.
Checks source year/context, exact candidates, action guards and conflict clearing.
Preserves source snapshot, reference occurrences and immutable input pins.
Requires all pinned input tables, reads required columns and validates source/output rows.

limits: No score reproduction or official member-action comparison is qualified by this review.
Member-name normalization was not broadened; unresolved rows remain explicit.
